description: This file contains C++ source code implementing functions and classes for creating and managing EFI System Partitions (ESP) images, including support for different architectures, file copying, directory creation, and EFI bootloader configuration for the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: EspBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating EFI System Partitions (ESP) images, allowing addition of files and directories, and final image construction.

classes.name: AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating EFI boot images for Android, supporting different architectures and EFI loader paths.

classes.name: LinuxEspBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating Linux boot EFI images, including configuration generation and file management.

classes.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating Fuchsia OS EFI images with multiboot and zedboot support.

methods.name: PrepareESP
methods.description: Prepares an EFI System Partition image with architecture-specific files and configurations.

methods.name: AddGrubConfig
methods.description: Adds GRUB configuration files to the EFI image.

methods.name: AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder::EfiLoaderPath
methods.description: Sets the EFI loader path for the Android EFI loader builder.

methods.name: AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder::Architecture
methods.description: Sets the architecture for the Android EFI loader builder.

methods.name: AndroidEfiLoaderEspBuilder::Build
methods.description: Builds the EFI image for Android with the specified loader path and architecture.

methods.name: LinuxEspBuilder::Argument
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments for the Linux kernel in the EFI image.

methods.name: LinuxEspBuilder::Root
methods.description: Sets the root device for the Linux kernel.

methods.name: LinuxEspBuilder::Architecture
methods.description: Sets the architecture for the Linux EFI image.

methods.name: LinuxEspBuilder::Build
methods.description: Constructs the Linux EFI image with the specified configuration.

methods.name: LinuxEspBuilder::DumpConfig
methods.description: Generates the GRUB configuration script for Linux boot.

methods.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder::MultibootBinary
methods.description: Sets the multiboot binary path for Fuchsia EFI image.

methods.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder::Zedboot
methods.description: Sets the zedboot image path for Fuchsia EFI image.

methods.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder::Architecture
methods.description: Sets the architecture for the Fuchsia EFI image.

methods.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder::Build
methods.description: Builds the Fuchsia EFI image with multiboot and zedboot.

methods.name: FuchsiaEspBuilder::DumpConfig
methods.description: Generates the GRUB configuration script for Fuchsia boot.
